scope: frozen10000 research sample,7635 unique exact texts; not fullpopulation or causal analysis
economic_question: Comparable work: entry signals, experience objects and explicit task/responsibility language in software- and AI-related recruitment. No seniority score inferred from a single word.
reuse: Original text/key linkage, frozen sample weights, dedup and V5 visible-text normalization preserved; normalization/heading helpers reused, old semantic labels not imported as truth.
outputs: experience object, strength, qualification path and explicit duration
explicit assistance, independent responsibility, people supervision, client ownership vs contact
technology mentions and locally supported role cues

interpretation.flag0: No rule hit, NOT proof of absent requirement
interpretation.multiobject: Preserved ambiguous joint clause, not automatically assigning same years to every object
interpretation.conditional: Do not convert education alternatives into universally required years
interpretation.seniorization: Separate observed dimensions, not blackbox composite
interpretation.technology: Mention/role cue, NOT actual adoption or exposure
interpretation.time: created_year is observed metadata, not proof currenttext valid then; no taskdeleted/added claim from snapshot
interpretation.entry: Do not define entry sample anew eachyear based on outcome requirements

sample_review.selection: Deterministic seed, strataA/B/C; prioritize exposedtexts fordevelopment, evaluation excludes all previously model-exposed exactSHAs and development. Preserve selectionreceipt.
sample_review.root_review: Read verbatim contextual packets with originaltext accessible; record actual review coverage and any truncated documents. Never report fulltext manualvalidation when only contexts read.
sample_review.freeze: Lock code before evaluating80; no iterative tuning against validation. At most one development correctionpass.

required: Code synthetic checks passed; sourcebinding and quoteoffset integrity
Every represented ad retained and null/unknowns reported
Review falsepositives and no-match omissions across technology strata
Report empirical exception workload before anyadvancedmodelspend
operational_gate.failure: Failed or unreviewed fields remain candidate/exploratory; no automatic acceptance from schema or consensus
operational_gate.budget_boundary: 20% exception share is planning trigger only, not literature accuracy standard

execution.qa: independent agent code review and scheduled synthetic tests
execution.return: Return verified artifacts toKunshan; removeuniqueBUstagingafterverification; preserveprovenance
